question: Find the name of authors who have never published a paper in ACL.
statements:
CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE authors AS
SELECT DISTINCT author_id, name_email_combined
FROM table_1

CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE paper_authorships AS
SELECT paper_id, aid
FROM table_2

CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE acl_venues AS
SELECT DISTINCT paper_id
FROM table_2
WHERE paper_id ~ '^[A-Z]{1,2}[0-9]{2}-[0-9]{4}$'
CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE "authors" AS SELECT DISTINCT author_id, name_email_combined FROM table_1
CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE "paper_authorships" AS SELECT paper_id, aid FROM table_2
CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE "acl_venues" AS SELECT DISTINCT paper_id FROM table_2 WHERE paper_id ~ '^[A-Z]{1,2}[0-9]{2}-[0-9]{4}$'

CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE conductor_s_execution AS
WITH acl_papers AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT paper_id
    FROM table_2 -- paper_authorships has paper_id
    WHERE paper_id ~ '^[A-Z]{1,2}[0-9]{2}-[0-9]{4}$'
),
acl_authors AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT a.aid AS author_id
    FROM table_2 a
    JOIN acl_papers p ON a.paper_id = p.paper_id
),
all_authors AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT author_id, name_email_combined
    FROM table_1
)
SELECT aa.author_id, aa.name_email_combined AS author_name
FROM all_authors aa
LEFT JOIN acl_authors ac ON aa.author_id = ac.author_id
WHERE ac.author_id IS NULL
ORDER BY aa.author_id
LIMIT 50;

CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE conductor_s_execution AS
WITH acl_authors AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT pa.aid AS author_id
    FROM paper_authorships pa
    JOIN acl_venues av ON pa.paper_id = av.paper_id
),
all_authors AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT author_id,

    FROM authors
),
clean_names AS (
    SELECT author_id,
           trim(raw_name) AS author_name
    FROM all_authors
)
SELECT cn.author_id, cn.author_name
FROM clean_names cn
LEFT JOIN acl_authors ac ON cn.author_id = ac.author_id
WHERE ac.author_id IS NULL
ORDER BY cn.author_id
LIMIT 50;

),
all_authors AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT author_id,
           split_part(name_email_combined, '|', 1) AS raw_name

),
clean_names AS (
    SELECT author_id,
           trim(
             replace(
               replace(
                 replace(
                   replace(
                     replace(
                       replace(
                         replace(
                           replace(
                             replace(
                               replace(raw_name, '&#x10D', 'č'),

                       '&#x130', 'İ'),
